model_answer: Taari sosay bee jemma, fofugo bee law, e sadugo fofugo nder bingel petel, musamman to o sali musnugo, alamaaji pewuri pofule (pneumonia) mawndi on. Salugo musnugo e waasugo ficugo holli nyaw man teddi, bo wakkatiiji goddi ɗum waddan hasari koo maayde to ɓe keɓaay lekki. Daada waadi boddum yaarki asibiti law, ngam bingel man do haaji laareego he6a lekki (antibiotics) koo henndu (oxygen) law-law.

Bawo ɗon, yaaru ɓingel ngel asibiti lawlaw ngam likita'en caanca ƴiiƴam, ɓe ndaara nyawu ko addi nguleeki kin ngam ɓe ndokka lekki ki dace.

Ko fii, si bingel maa woppata ko “sweet” walla “fruity”, ɗum naftortoo ko sukar maa ena ɗaw (diabetes) oɗon no feewi.  
Si woppere ndee jogii e tuufa, bonngo, yeeso yeeso, njippu (burning) so a yahi, walla fever, ɓeɗooga ko ɓuri ko njiyataa, ena heɓii ko njiyataa e urinary tract infection.  
Si alaa ndiyam a nyaam, a waawi waɗde bingel maa woppata ko ɓuri; ngam ɗum, a nyaama ndiyam no feewi.  
So alaa ndiyan-ɗiyan, goonga ɗiɗi, ciɗɗol e laanaaji, sukar, walla a heɓii ɗum e goonga e seeɗa, yah to casu marabouto/doctor ngam lab diiwa e njiyataa.

Ko fii amin woni e haɗari, waɗɗa laawol kisal: so o waɗi ko ndiyam, e yidi ɓe faamu, jippu e ɓe, yowru e ɓe ɓuri kisal, tee so ina woodi, yahi ɗum ena sa’e e maɓɓe.  
Hollu ɓe njabbama, go’dooji, koode maɓɓe, wallata e arɗo wuro, koode addini, walla police, ngam ɗiɗal e goongaajo kisa do’otal.  
So kunuɗo e yaran maa waɗi ɓernde, yahi asibiti ngam kulol, tee waɗi ɗum goongaajo dokkal e hakkunde kisal.  
Waɗɗa laawol kisal e nder suudu: joga ko ɓuri yowru haa saare, waɗɗa doggol kala, tee waɗi “plan” ngam yahrude so ko feewi.  
Husbun maa ina naamna aafiya: ina foti waɗtude ko oɗon yiɗi, jippu e gite ɓe, tee so o yidi, njillo e jangoowo ko waɗi huɓɓaaji ngam jukkirde.
